name: Contextick
description:
Contextick is a personal knowledge layer for your AI. Save any text once — a decision, an idea, a code snippet, research notes — and the AIs you connect can bring it back later by meaning, right when it's relevant.

Because your knowledge lives in one private store instead of inside a single assistant, it follows you across every MCP-compatible assistant you connect. Save something in one, recall it in another.

There's nothing to organize: no folders, no tags. You just save, and a short bit of context surfaces the closest match when you ask. Use it to keep working decisions, team conventions, preferences, and anything you'd rather not explain to your AI twice.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Contextick to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Contextick to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://contextick.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Contextick MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Contextick provides these MCP tools: delete, get, least_opened, most_opened, save, search, and usage.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Contextick?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Contextick in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Contextick requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Contextick is developed by Maverick Works. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
